specification.exact_target: Expression levels of viral histone genes (MV-H2B-H2A, MV-H4-H3, MV-miniH2B-H2A) and host histone chaperone genes during the Melbournevirus infectious cycle, reported as log-transformed counts per million (CPM) and scaled Z-scores in a heatmap (Figure 2A).
specification.blind_target: The temporal expression profile of viral histone genes and host histone chaperone genes during the Melbournevirus infectious cycle in Acanthamoeba castellanii.

location_quotes.quote: Analysis of published transcriptomic data obtained for a member of the Marseilleviridae during its infectious cycle in A. castellanii ( Rodrigues et al., 2020 ) sheds light on the possible contribution of the host to viral nucleosome assembly ( Figure 2 A).

method_quotes.quote: We first annotated the Marseillevirus genome (accession GU071086 ) as described ( Blanca et al., 2020 ), as well as the A. castellanii Neff host genome (assembly GCA_000193105.1) using the Funannotate pipeline (version 1.7; https://github.com/nextgenusfs/funannotate ).

We then mapped the RNA-seq reads corresponding to 30 min pi (ERR3528397), 1 h pi (ERR3528398), 2 h pi (ERR3528399), 4 h pi (ERR3528400), 5 h pi (ERR3528401), 6 h pi (ERR3528402), 8 h pi (ERR3528403), 10 h pi (ERR3528404) and 12 h pi (ERR3528405) to the host and viral

transcripts using Bowtie ( Langmead and Salzberg, 2012 ) (version 2.3.4.1). Transcript quantification was done using RSEM ( Li and Dewey, 2011 ) (version 1.3.0) and data normalization using the edgeR R package ( Robinson et al., 2010 ). Host and viral mapped reads were normalized separately with the “TMMwsp” method and then combined to a single matrix.

Expression values were then expressed in log transformed counts per million of mapped reads (CPM). Finally, we scaled each transcript expression values to a Z-score and produced a heatmap for the genes of interest.

specification.input_notes: RNA-seq reads from SRA study ERP117375; run accessions as listed. Host genome assembly GCA_000193105.1 and viral genome GU071086 are required but not in the deposit.
specification.comparison_metric: Comparison of expression values (log CPM or Z-scores) for viral histone genes and host chaperone genes across time points.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: For expression values, agreement within the displayed rounding bin (e.g., Z-scores to one decimal place); for presence/absence of expression, exact match.
specification.specification_gaps: The exact set of genes included in the heatmap, the precise normalization parameters (e.g., TMMwsp settings), and the clustering method are not fully specified.
specification.alternatives_considered: The mass spectrometry proteomics table (Table 1) was considered but rejected because the target is the transcriptome analysis, which is the principal quantitative result for gene expression.
